# netbox_virtual_disk (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/virtualization/virtualdisk/):
> A virtual disk is used to model discrete virtual hard disks assigned to virtual machines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Assumes vmw-cluster-01 exists in Netbox
data "netbox_cluster" "vmw_cluster_01" {
  name = "vmw-cluster-01"
}

resource "netbox_virtual_machine" "base_vm" {
  cluster_id = data.netbox_cluster.vmw_cluster_01.id
  name       = "myvm-1"
}

resource "netbox_virtual_disk" "example" {
  name               = "disk-01"
  description        = "Main disk"
  size_mb            = 50
  virtual_machine_id = netbox_virtual_machine.base_vm.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the virtual disk.
- `size_mb` (Number) The size mb of the virtual disk.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual machine associated with the virtual disk.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the virtual disk.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the virtual disk. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_virtual_disk.example 1
```
